findings.title: Archive is not hermetic despite passing certifier
findings.why_it_matters: Cargo metadata succeeded from parent /Coding/Libraries workspace with 326 packages/30 workspace members while the archive has zero workspace manifests. A clean extractor may fail or resolve differently.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an archive-root Cargo.toml workspace, or remove workspace-only dependency/lint reliance; validate from fresh extraction.

findings.title: No packaged root workspace manifest for included local crates
findings.why_it_matters: The zip includes semantic-memory plus three path roots, but no top-level workspace manifest tying them together.
findings.suggested_fix: Generate a root Cargo.toml with members semantic-memory, stack-ids, semantic-memory-forge, forge-memory-bridge.

findings.title: Multiple Cargo.lock files create ambiguous dependency source of truth
findings.why_it_matters: Each included package has its own lockfile; without a packaged root workspace, dependency resolution can differ between crates.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one workspace lockfile at archive root for review builds or document crate-by-crate build commands.

findings.title: Document ingest silently truncates chunks on embedder batch-count mismatch
findings.why_it_matters: text_chunks.iter().zip(embeddings.iter()) drops chunks if the embedder returns fewer vectors, and ignores extra vectors.
findings.suggested_fix: Centralize embed_batch validation: returned len must equal requested len before any write.

findings.title: Fact re-embedding silently truncates on batch-count mismatch
findings.why_it_matters: Batch rows are zipped with embeddings; fewer embeddings still increments fact_count by batch.len().
findings.suggested_fix: Fail loudly on batch-count mismatch before constructing updates.

findings.title: Chunk re-embedding silently truncates on batch-count mismatch
findings.why_it_matters: Batch rows are zipped with embeddings; missing embeddings leave stale rows while progress counters report success.
findings.suggested_fix: Fail loudly on batch-count mismatch before update transaction.

findings.title: Message re-embedding silently truncates on batch-count mismatch
findings.why_it_matters: Batch rows are zipped with embeddings; message embeddings can be partially refreshed without being reported.
findings.suggested_fix: Fail loudly on batch-count mismatch before update transaction.

findings.title: Episode re-embedding silently truncates on batch-count mismatch
findings.why_it_matters: Batch rows are zipped with embeddings; missing episode embeddings can leave stale recall state.
findings.suggested_fix: Fail loudly on batch-count mismatch before update transaction.

findings.title: Public embedding validation is dimension-only
findings.why_it_matters: validate_embedding_dimensions checks length but not NaN/Inf, while HNSW later rejects non-finite values; SQLite can still store bad f32 blobs.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with validate_embedding that checks dimensions and all components finite.

findings.title: delete_document does not explicitly clean episode derived state
findings.why_it_matters: Document deletion removes chunks/docs but not episode_causes, episodes_fts, episodes_rowid_map, or episode HNSW ops before cascade/cleanup boundaries.
findings.suggested_fix: Collect episode_ids first and delete all episode derived surfaces plus queued HNSW deletes in one transaction.

findings.title: delete_document can leave stale HNSW episode keys
findings.why_it_matters: If episodes are cascaded from documents, HNSW sidecar does not know about episode deletes unless explicit pending ops are queued.
findings.suggested_fix: Queue Delete for every episode:{episode_id} before deleting the document.

findings.title: Vector scan uses bytemuck::try_cast_slice on SQLite Vec<u8>
findings.why_it_matters: SQLite blobs are byte vectors; casting requires alignment and native endian assumptions. Valid blobs may fail or decode incorrectly on non-little-endian targets.
findings.suggested_fix: Use db::bytes_to_embedding for all blob decoding; avoid bytemuck on storage bytes.

findings.title: HNSW sidecar loader allocates raw byte_len from file without cap
findings.why_it_matters: A corrupt sidecar can declare a huge byte length and trigger large allocation before validation.
findings.suggested_fix: Require byte_len == dimensions*4 and <= configured max before allocation.

findings.title: HNSW data format stores dimensions using usize
findings.why_it_matters: usize serialization is platform-width dependent; sidecar created on 64-bit may not load on 32-bit and is not a stable portable format.
findings.suggested_fix: Use fixed-width u32/u64 little-endian fields with versioned header.

findings.title: HNSW save is not atomic
findings.why_it_matters: file_dump writes directly; crash or process kill can leave partial graph/data sidecars.
findings.suggested_fix: Write to temp files, fsync, then atomic rename graph/data/keymap as a set.

findings.title: Pending HNSW mutations are applied before sidecar save succeeds
findings.why_it_matters: If save fails after mutating in-memory index, pending ops remain and can be applied again, creating duplicate tombstones/nodes.
findings.suggested_fix: Build/save a snapshot or roll back in-memory mutations on save failure.

findings.title: Pending upsert calls insert instead of update
findings.why_it_matters: Upsert on an existing key allocates a new node and tombstones the old node, increasing graph bloat on repeated retries.
findings.suggested_fix: Use update() or replace semantics for existing keys; dedupe pending ops by key.

findings.title: HNSW sidecar save clones Arc while graph can still mutate
findings.why_it_matters: Cloning HnswIndex does not snapshot the underlying graph; concurrent writes can mutate while save is in progress.
findings.suggested_fix: Hold exclusive lock during save or introduce immutable snapshot serialization.

findings.title: Graph sidecar validation only checks non-empty file
findings.why_it_matters: validate_graph_sidecar does not verify magic/version/consistency with data/keymap.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate graph/data/keymap together with checksums and stored dimensions/counts.

findings.title: HNSW integrity is count-based, not key-level
findings.why_it_matters: Equal counts can hide wrong mappings, stale IDs, or wrong source types.
findings.suggested_fix: Verify each keymap key maps to a live row and each live embedded row has a matching key.

findings.title: FTS integrity count checks use dynamic table names and count parity only
findings.why_it_matters: Count parity can pass despite rowid/content mismatches.
findings.suggested_fix: Perform key-level rowid_map/content checks for every FTS-backed table.

findings.title: cosine_similarity truncates mismatched vectors in release builds
findings.why_it_matters: debug_assert_eq is disabled in release; zip then compares only the shorter length.
findings.suggested_fix: Return Result or validate dimensions before zip in all builds.

findings.title: cosine similarity accepts non-finite stored/query vectors
findings.why_it_matters: NaN/Inf can produce NaN scores and unstable sorting.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate finite vectors before storage and skip/error on non-finite during reads.

findings.title: HNSW filtered search can return empty results without brute-force fallback
findings.why_it_matters: HNSW gets global candidates before namespace/session/source-type filters; if filtered candidates are removed, valid rows outside the top candidate pool are missed.
findings.suggested_fix: Overfetch adaptively after filters or fallback to brute force when post-filter hits < k.

findings.title: conversation HNSW search runs blocking CPU work on async thread
findings.why_it_matters: It directly holds the HNSW read lock and searches in async context, unlike main hnsw_search_blocking.
findings.suggested_fix: Route through spawn_blocking helper.

findings.title: delete_fact does not clean episode_causes references
findings.why_it_matters: Deleting a fact queues HNSW delete and removes FTS, but episodes may still cite the fact as a cause.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete or mark episode_causes rows referencing the fact and update affected episode search/provenance.

findings.title: update_fact does not update dependent episode/projection search text
findings.why_it_matters: Fact content changes can make derived episode/projection references semantically stale.
findings.suggested_fix: Record invalidation edges or recompute affected derived search surfaces.

findings.title: delete_namespace returns only fact count despite deleting many entity types
findings.why_it_matters: The API return value underreports blast radius and can make receipts/logs false.
findings.suggested_fix: Return NamespaceDeleteReport with counts per entity/table/op.

findings.title: Open-time HNSW rebuild/degrade policy is implicit
findings.why_it_matters: The open path may rebuild/clear/swap indexes based on metadata without an explicit user-visible startup policy.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose HnswStartupPolicy and health status.

findings.title: SQL errors while counting embeddings are swallowed as zero
findings.why_it_matters: query_row(...).unwrap_or(0) can suppress a DB error and avoid needed rebuild.
findings.suggested_fix: Propagate DB errors during integrity decisions.

findings.title: Orphan-count SQL errors are swallowed as zero
findings.why_it_matters: A failed orphan check can make a stale keymap appear clean.
findings.suggested_fix: Propagate the error or force degraded/rebuild state.

findings.title: Missing hnsw_keymap table silently leaves loaded graph without keys
findings.why_it_matters: load_keymap returns Ok with empty keymap; graph points become unresolvable.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat graph+missing keymap as degraded/rebuild, not clean load.

findings.title: Malformed next_id metadata falls back silently
findings.why_it_matters: Invalid next_id is parsed with ok/unwrap_or graph point count.
findings.suggested_fix: Report error or mark sidecar stale when metadata is malformed.

findings.title: HNSW len can report nonzero even when keymap is empty
findings.why_it_matters: len uses graph point count minus deleted IDs, not resolvable key count.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose separate graph_len and live_key_count; search should use resolvable key count.

findings.title: Tombstone overfetch is too naive
findings.why_it_matters: fetch_count = top_k + deleted_ids.len() still can miss valid neighbors if tombstones cluster near the query.
findings.suggested_fix: Iteratively overfetch until enough live hits or graph exhausted.

findings.title: deleted_ratio may divide using graph count that includes unreachable/unmapped points
findings.why_it_matters: Compaction threshold can be misleading if keymap drift exists.
findings.suggested_fix: Compute deleted/live ratios from verified keymap state.

findings.title: u64 node id is cast to usize without range check
findings.why_it_matters: Sidecar with node id > usize::MAX truncates on 32-bit and can corrupt mapping.
findings.suggested_fix: TryFrom<u64> with explicit error.

findings.title: insert ignores return/status from hnsw_rs graph.insert
findings.why_it_matters: If insertion fails or panics internally, keymap may still be updated.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap insert in catch_unwind if needed and use API result if available; update keymap only after success.

findings.title: HNSW rebuild silently skips invalid fact embeddings
findings.why_it_matters: db::bytes_to_embedding errors are ignored, producing an incomplete index.
findings.suggested_fix: Count skipped rows and return degraded integrity finding.

findings.title: HNSW rebuild silently skips invalid chunk embeddings
findings.why_it_matters: Invalid embeddings are dropped without a repair error.
findings.suggested_fix: Count skipped rows and expose rebuild diagnostics.

findings.title: HNSW rebuild silently skips invalid message embeddings
findings.why_it_matters: Invalid message embeddings are dropped without a repair error.
findings.suggested_fix: Count skipped rows and expose rebuild diagnostics.

findings.title: HNSW rebuild silently skips invalid episode embeddings
findings.why_it_matters: Invalid episode embeddings are dropped without a repair error.
findings.suggested_fix: Count skipped rows and expose rebuild diagnostics.

findings.title: clear_pending_index_ops is all-or-nothing per processed key list after sidecar save
findings.why_it_matters: If keymap flush succeeds but clear fails, mutations may be replayed and duplicate/tombstone bloat occurs.
findings.suggested_fix: Use transactional state machine with op generation numbers and idempotent upsert.

findings.title: q8 optionality conflicts with integrity expectations
findings.why_it_matters: Code comments say q8 is optional/non-fatal, but full integrity can treat missing q8 as an issue.
findings.suggested_fix: Define compressed vectors as mandatory or optional; align write, repair, and integrity.

findings.title: q8 baseline lacks explicit versioned storage envelope
findings.why_it_matters: Packed q8 bytes need version/dims/scale metadata for future TurboQuant coexistence.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a vector-codec envelope with codec, version, dim, checksum, and params.

findings.title: Invalid timestamp becomes maximally fresh
findings.why_it_matters: days_since(ts).unwrap_or(0.0) makes parse failures age 0 after a warning.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat invalid timestamps as no recency contribution or stale.

findings.title: recency scoring uses wall-clock inside ranking
findings.why_it_matters: Utc::now makes ranking nondeterministic and hard to test/replay.
findings.suggested_fix: Inject clock into SearchConfig or query context.

findings.title: candidate_pool_size.max(k * 3) can overflow
findings.why_it_matters: usize multiplication can overflow for large top_k.
findings.suggested_fix: Use k.saturating_mul(3) and cap top_k.

findings.title: Second candidate_pool_size.max(k * 3) overflow surface
findings.why_it_matters: Same unbounded top_k multiplication appears in another search path.
findings.suggested_fix: Use saturating_mul and configured max_top_k.

findings.title: Third candidate_pool_size.max(k * 3) overflow surface
findings.why_it_matters: Same unbounded top_k multiplication appears in another path.
findings.suggested_fix: Use saturating_mul and configured max_top_k.

findings.title: conversation candidate_pool_size.max(k * 3) overflow surface
findings.why_it_matters: Unbounded top_k multiplication in conversation search.
findings.suggested_fix: Use saturating_mul and configured max_top_k.

findings.title: Unknown token counts are treated as zero in budget selection
findings.why_it_matters: Messages with missing token_count can bypass max_tokens.
findings.suggested_fix: Recompute missing token_count or treat unknown as conservative upper bound.

findings.title: Token budget addition can overflow u32
findings.why_it_matters: total_tokens + msg_tokens may overflow before comparison.
findings.suggested_fix: Use checked_add/saturating_add and error or clamp.

findings.title: session_token_count casts negative SQL sum to u64
findings.why_it_matters: If corrupt rows contain negative token_count, cast wraps to huge positive.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate nonnegative aggregate before conversion.

findings.title: Session/channel identifiers are not consistently length/whitespace validated
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed or huge identifiers can leak into storage and logs.
findings.suggested_fix: Centralize validation for session_id, channel, namespace, title, source URI.

findings.title: Document title/source/metadata size validation is weaker than content validation
findings.why_it_matters: Large metadata/title/source strings can bloat DB and docs.
findings.suggested_fix: Add max lengths and metadata byte caps.

findings.title: Episode search limit is unbounded
findings.why_it_matters: A caller can request a huge limit and cause large result materialization.
findings.suggested_fix: Cap limit using config max_top_k/max_query_rows.

findings.title: search_episodes drops episode_id and returns document_id
findings.why_it_matters: Multiple episodes per document cannot be distinguished by caller.
findings.suggested_fix: Return episode_id plus document_id or a typed EpisodeSearchResult.

findings.title: Episode parse errors report document_id instead of episode_id
findings.why_it_matters: Diagnostic row id for cause_ids/outcome/status points to document_id, not the episode row.
findings.suggested_fix: Use episode_id in parse helpers.

findings.title: INSERT OR IGNORE collapses duplicate cause IDs silently
findings.why_it_matters: Duplicate causes with different ordinal positions are discarded.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate and reject duplicate cause_ids or preserve multiplicity intentionally.

findings.title: update_episode_outcome cannot clear experiment_id
findings.why_it_matters: COALESCE(?3, experiment_id) preserves old experiment_id when None is passed.
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit clear operation or Option<Option<String>> semantics.

findings.title: HNSW key parsing split_once(:) is fragile for IDs containing colon
findings.why_it_matters: Episode/document/user-provided IDs may contain colon unless validated.
findings.suggested_fix: Use structured key encoding or reject colon in IDs.

findings.title: Message dedup key uses session_id:message_id delimiter
findings.why_it_matters: If session_id contains colon, downstream parsing/dedup diagnostics can become ambiguous.
findings.suggested_fix: Use tuple type internally or escaped/keyed serialization.

findings.title: Correctness depends on PRAGMA foreign_keys being enabled for every pooled connection
findings.why_it_matters: Cascades/derived cleanup assumptions fail if a connection misses the pragma.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON after every connection checkout.

findings.title: PRAGMA max_page_count computed with dynamic formatting
findings.why_it_matters: Even though value is numeric, config-derived PRAGMA should be validated/capped.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate max_page_count range before execute.

findings.title: Dynamic table_info table name formatting relies on internal callers only
findings.why_it_matters: If any caller ever passes user input, PRAGMA table_info becomes injection-prone.
findings.suggested_fix: Make table an enum or whitelist.

findings.title: Dynamic ALTER TABLE formatting relies on internal table/column whitelists
findings.why_it_matters: Schema migration helpers must not accept arbitrary strings.
findings.suggested_fix: Make migration table/column identifiers enum-backed.

findings.title: Dynamic SELECT COUNT table name relies on internal map table list
findings.why_it_matters: Future caller could turn table name into SQL injection.
findings.suggested_fix: Use enum/constant-only function signature.

findings.title: SQLite WAL/checkpoint/backpressure policy not visible in archive-level docs
findings.why_it_matters: Long-running local stores need defined WAL/checkpoint/backup behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Document and test WAL mode, busy timeout, checkpoint, and backup semantics.

findings.title: Connection pool shutdown/poison behavior needs stress coverage
findings.why_it_matters: spawn_blocking and pool handoff may hide panics as Other, but lifecycle correctness needs proof.
findings.suggested_fix: Add pool close/drop/concurrent open tests under load.

findings.title: Projection storage integrity is likely separate from memory integrity
findings.why_it_matters: Projection tables are substantial but not obviously covered by full integrity parity.
findings.suggested_fix: Add projection-level integrity: rows, derivations, episodes, imports, claim versions.

findings.title: Projection query uses unwrap_or_default for missing claim/source IDs
findings.why_it_matters: Missing IDs become empty strings, hiding malformed rows.
findings.suggested_fix: Return structured parse/error instead of default empty identifiers.

findings.title: Bridge transform uses unwrap_or_default, potentially hiding malformed optional payloads
findings.why_it_matters: Defaulting in bridge paths can mask corrupted envelope fields.
findings.suggested_fix: Emit explicit transform error or warning with field name.

findings.title: JSON import begins with from_str(...).ok()
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed JSON is converted into None instead of a typed parse error at the earliest boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve parse error and source payload hash in import receipt.

findings.title: Legacy compatibility serializes with unwrap_or_default
findings.why_it_matters: Serialization failure becomes empty string, which can look like valid empty JSON.
findings.suggested_fix: Return error on serialization failure.

findings.title: HTTP embedder response body uses unwrap_or_default on error
findings.why_it_matters: Failed response body read can erase useful diagnostic details.
findings.suggested_fix: Propagate body-read error or preserve status + partial diagnostics.

findings.title: External embedder failure modes need retry/backoff/rate-limit policy
findings.why_it_matters: Embedding APIs are external/unreliable; partial failures are currently risky for batch workflows.
findings.suggested_fix: Add retry policy, per-batch timeout, and idempotent transaction boundaries.

findings.title: Prompt docs are packaged at project root
findings.why_it_matters: Prompt artifacts are useful internally but noisy for external review.
findings.suggested_fix: Move prompt files under docs/internal/codex/ or exclude public packages.

findings.title: Implementation prompt is packaged at project root
findings.why_it_matters: Root prompt files dilute the README/API/architecture signal.
findings.suggested_fix: Archive or relocate prompt files.

findings.title: Patch prompt is packaged at project root
findings.why_it_matters: Root patch prompt looks stale/internal to reviewers.
findings.suggested_fix: Archive or relocate prompt files.

findings.title: V2 patch prompt is packaged at project root
findings.why_it_matters: Stale patch prompt can confuse source of truth.
findings.suggested_fix: Archive or relocate prompt files.

findings.title: Prior codex sidecar is included in current source package
findings.why_it_matters: The previous codex archive report is not source and can confuse current package state.
findings.suggested_fix: Exclude generated/codex sidecars consistently.

findings.title: Most source/docs are marked executable
findings.why_it_matters: Executable bits on .rs/.md/.toml/.lock files create noisy diffs and false script signals.
findings.suggested_fix: Normalize permissions: 0644 for non-scripts, 0755 only for actual executables.

findings.title: No packaged CI workflow surface
findings.why_it_matters: The archive does not show .github/workflows for cargo check/test/clippy/doc.
findings.suggested_fix: Add CI for all features, no-default-features variants, and clean extraction build.

findings.title: No benchmark suite/result artifact included
findings.why_it_matters: TurboQuant/HNSW/q8 claims need performance/recall evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Add benches and BENCHMARKS.md with f32/q8/HNSW/TurboQuant matrix.

findings.title: lib.rs is very large and high blast-radius
findings.why_it_matters: Large orchestrator file makes localized correctness review harder.
findings.suggested_fix: Split store open/search/reembed/delete/integrity modules after P0 fixes.

findings.title: db.rs is very large and high blast-radius
findings.why_it_matters: Schema/migration/metadata/ops all in one module reduce auditability.
findings.suggested_fix: Split schema/migrations/integrity/hnsw metadata helpers.

findings.title: search.rs combines lexical, vector, HNSW resolution, fusion, scoring
findings.why_it_matters: Mixed responsibilities make ranking bugs harder to isolate.
findings.suggested_fix: Split search/fts.rs vector.rs hnsw.rs fusion.rs explain.rs.
